summary: Preinstall exfiltrates host identifiers to oastify.com Collaborator endpoint
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` hook executes `index.js`, which collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.platform(), os.arch(), os.homedir(), and configured DNS servers via dns.getServers()) and POSTs them to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain at iaw5sqvrkqmghau6kwlwtalpqgw8k88x.oastify.com/hit. The destination is an out-of-band interaction endpoint controlled by an external party, not a first-party service of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
